title: QA Pilot Project Validation Profile
description: Binds a governed project to its applicable QA-Pilot validation domains. Resolved at startup to determine what testing, which contracts, and what review gates apply to a project. The startup contract announces QA-Pilot availability; this profile explains what that means for the specific project.

project_id.description: The governed project this profile applies to

project_type.description: Project type — determines default domain availability

enabled_domains.description: Test domains enabled for this project

required_reviews.description: Required review gates before validation results can be acted upon

contract_refs.description: QA-Pilot contracts applicable to this project

evidence_source.description: Where this project's evidence comes from (SDK, filesystem, project adapter)

adapter_ref.description: Optional reference to a project adapter configuration

resolved_by.description: How this profile was resolved (startup plugin, project configuration, adapter)

available.description: Whether QA-Pilot validation is available at startup

startup_routing.description: Startup routing context — how this profile connects to the project's startup flow

advisory_only.description: Validation profiles are advisory — they do not confer authority

no_seal_authority.description: Profile does not confer seal authority
